caption: The drawing depicts a grayscale illustration of a man seated in a two-wheeled cart or sulky, which is being pulled by a galloping horse. The man is wearing a cap and is holding the reins attached to the horse's bridle. The sulky has two large spoke wheels and a simple seat. The horse is shown in mid-stride with all four legs off the ground, indicating movement. The cart and horse appear to be mounted on a rectangular support structure depicted beneath them. The drawing is rendered with fine lines and shading to suggest volume and texture, and is set against a plain, light background with a thin rectangular border. There is a signature in the bottom left corner. The entire composition uses a limited range of grey and black tones on an off-white or beige background.
title: Weather Vane Finial
